title: Ambient scalar quotient normalization
statement:
theorem ambientQuotientScalarModel_normalization_exists (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra ℚ_[l] L] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] L) (X : Scheme.{t})
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E X)
    (ρ : IntegralComparisonRoosModel l L X) :
    ∃ realization : integralScalarExtensionOfUniverses l E L ι X ≅
        S.reduction ⋙ integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar l E L ι X ⋙
          coefficientSequenceLimit l L X,
      IsIntegralComparisonScalarNormalized l E L ι X S ρ realization

proof.text: Use CompletionUnit.fixedCalculusModels to obtain an ordinary quotient model M and its normalized derived comparison D for the supplied S, without imposing invertibility of l on the scheme. Form the ordinary scalar tower isomorphism by balanced tensor association.

Reuse the primitive scalar construction's proved sequenceKFlat_of_evaluations helper: evaluated quotients of a good complex are K-flat, and componentwise tensor and exactness imply whole-system K-flatness. Thus the universal derived scalar cochain counit computes there. Compose with the supplied normalized Roos comparison and balanced association to obtain a natural isomorphism on good complexes. The universal good-complex localization descends it to a chosen ambient realization.

Whole-system coherence compares any simultaneous quotient presentation to M by a strict chain isomorphism a. Transport the balanced scalar tower comparison along a inverse. Its generator formula is the prescribed tensor normalization. Naturality of the scalar counit and Roos comparison moves Q(a) across the comparison, cancels it against a inverse, and reduces the whole-system equation to the descended comparison equation. Return this chosen realization together with normalization.
